claims.claim: It is a large, full colour laser multifunctional printer
claims.evidence: Witness report confirms multifunction printer/copier form factor but does not show a test print or color capability; color/laser engine type not visually confirmable from the photo.

claims.claim: The model is C754e (bizhub PRO C754e)
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows brand 'KONICA MINOLTA' and model text 'bizhub PRO C754e' printed on the front panel.

risks.risk: Unit may not power on or may have internal faults
risks.proof: Video of machine powering on, displaying home screen, and completing a test print/copy
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-functional / for-parts worst case

risks.risk: High or unknown page/usage counter indicating heavy wear on drum, fuser, belt
risks.proof: Photo or screenshot of the service/usage counter on the touchscreen menu

risks.risk: Missing or empty toner cartridges, drums, or fuser unit
risks.proof: Photos of open consumable bays showing installed toner/drum/fuser
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete, requiring full consumable replacement

risks.risk: Exposure to outdoor elements (dust, moisture, rust) from sitting on bare concrete
risks.proof: Close-up photos of rear/side panels, vents, and internal paper path for corrosion or water ingress
risks.if_unproven: priced as environmentally damaged risk, deducted as if moisture-affected

risks.risk: Missing accessories: cables, power cord, trays 2-4 contents, finisher or feeder completeness
risks.proof: Full set photo of all trays open plus cables/accessories laid out
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete unit, accessories to be sourced separately

risks.risk: Plastic wrap still on may hide shipping damage or unresolved assembly
risks.proof: Photo with wrap fully removed showing top cover and scanner glass condition
risks.if_unproven: priced as condition-unverified, worst case cosmetic/mechanical damage assumed

risks.risk: No service/error history disclosed; possible recurring error codes
risks.proof: Screenshot of error log or service history printout from the machine menu
risks.if_unproven: priced as having undocumented fault risk

proof_requests: Video of the machine powering on and performing a test print/copy in color
Photo/screenshot of the usage/page counter from the control panel
Photos of all paper trays open and any installed toner/drum/fuser units
Close-up photos of rear and side panels for rust, corrosion, or water damage
Photo of the machine with all packaging/plastic wrap removed
Photo of power cable, network cable, and any accessories included
response.reason: The witness confirms the item's identity (Konica Minolta bizhub PRO C754e multifunction printer) but functionality, consumables, and condition are unverified, so it must be priced at worst case pending the listed proofs.
